artboards.title: Agent portal — the same bar, renamed

annotations.text:
The global bar carries the app's only h1, so navigation and identity survive the breakpoint where the sidebar is hidden.

On /inbox it reads Agent portal, in green with a green top rule. Green already means "a person is involved" in this system, so the operator side wears it rather than inventing a sixth colour.

The manual appears in two places on purpose: the header shows the scope you are in, the sidebar list is where you change it.

They must always agree. If the header says BJ30 and the sidebar highlights X55, the screen is lying about which document the answers came from, which is the one thing this product cannot get wrong.

Both drive the same selection, so build them from one state, never two.

Reference: Cloudscape, the AWS console system. Open Sans on its exact type scale, 14px body.

Amazon Ember is not licensable by third parties, so it is out.

Deliberately not taking AWS identity: no AWS orange, no console chrome. If the demo looks like an AWS product, the client asks whether it is one.
